# poopdeck.gl / SpatioTemporal Tiles (STT)

> Time-aware vector tiles. STT packs large spatiotemporal datasets (points, paths,
> polygons, trips, flows, events) into streamable, animated `.stt` archives and
> renders them with deck.gl (or Three.js/WebGPU, MapLibre, Cesium). Rust CLIs
> build / optimize / serve the archives; TypeScript packages read and render them.
> An MCP server + Agent Skills (the `poopdeck-ai` plugin) provide the AI surface.

> **For AI agents:** the entire published documentation corpus is available as a
> single plain-text document at https://poopdeck.gl/llms-full.txt, and each doc
> below is mirrored under https://poopdeck.gl/llms/.

## Start here
- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/BertCh/spatiotemporal-tiles/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how coding agents should work in this repo.
- [Concepts](docs/intro/concepts.md): the space×time tile model, packed archives, playback.
- [Choosing an approach](docs/intro/choosing.md): static vs served; which renderer.
- [CSV quickstart](docs/guides/csv-quickstart.md): fastest path from a table to a map.
- [System overview](docs/architecture/system-overview.md): how the pieces fit.

## Command-line tools
- [CLI reference](docs/api/cli-reference.md): canonical flags for `stt-build`, `stt-optimize`, `stt-serve`, `stt-validate`.
- [Build a dataset](docs/guides/csv-quickstart.md): `stt-build` from GeoParquet / PostGIS / DuckDB.
- [Tune & lint tiles](docs/guides/tuning-tiles.md): `stt-optimize` inspect/doctor/diff/order-audit; publish encoding.
- [Serve & deploy](docs/guides/deploying.md): `stt-serve` and static publishing to a CDN/R2.

## Rendering
- [SpatioTemporalLayer](docs/api/spatiotemporal-layer.md): the deck.gl chassis (time/tier/scrubLod/prefetch props).
- [deck.gl integration](docs/architecture/deckgl-integration.md): the layer families and how they compose.
- [Extensions](docs/api/extensions.md): TimeFilter, DataFilter, CategoryColor, CollisionFilter, ChevronFlow, Splat.
- [Playback](docs/api/stt-player.md): `SttPlayer` / `PlaybackGovernor` and the React bindings.

## Format & protocol
- [Packed format spec](docs/spec/stt-packed-format.md): manifest + content-addressed packs, directory v5, quant/zstd.
- [Serve protocol](docs/spec/stt-serve-protocol.md): dynamic tile routes.
- [Time model](docs/spec/time-model.md): buckets, LOD pyramid, temporal bounds.
